outcome.technical: R72: merge-manifest resolve compares each plan file with git's own answer for the merge (git merge-tree --write-tree read through checkout's filters), not the index; where git cannot answer it rebuilds the merge path by path (driver or git merge-file with the repository's conflict style and the file's conflict-marker-size), and that fallback may differ from git in exactly three named ways (labels, diff algorithm, merge base), each with its fixture (rw16). A marker line may differ only by a label git or the driver would write there (HEAD/MERGE_HEAD/merge-base revisions, the driver's labels); a typed note or trailing space is refused (rw19). Symlinked or unreadable plan files are refused; refusals name the commands that put each file back. R73/R74: tools/lints/_deps.py plan_writer_violations reports an unlocatable path argument at the caller, reads module-level units, star/aliased imports, importlib, os.renames, numeric os.open flags, Path open(mode=)/touch/rename, judges every forwarded parameter, keeps a parameter through str/os.fspath/abspath/realpath/normpath/expanduser/pathlib/join-of-carried-parts (point 1 of review read 2), counts OTHER_WRITERS entries as a multiset, ties a write to the plan by name or literal, and requires a plan row's case label to name its function (or the door case for a door). Rows: PLAN 55, OTHER 85 rows/110 entries -> 89/116 this last round; deciders 149 -> 153, sites 179 -> 184 (write_map is a comparison artifact). Lint time 3.39/3.29 s (round-3 lint) vs 3.65/3.45 s now, interleaved with a 30 s gap. tests/test__evidence_io.py: pa0b/pa0c derive the doors of audit-task._under_lock and close-phase.under_index_lock and mark only a handed lambda's body or a handed def's body as locked; pm4/pm5 for seed (a race-created plan, a pre-existing directory or dangling link, each named as what it is). R75: repair-tests-add refuses when nothing is left to apply (rt17), the commits repair's window-miss branch (rc13), busy vs dead holder vs unwritable lock wording (uw4-uw7), drive reads the busy sentence from the runner's refusal line (dl12b), docs (CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE, layout.md).
